notes.title: Long Time Between Updates
notes.content:
Hello Ember Fans,

We know it has been a long time since our last update. We had changes in our staff and it took a little while to find the right people to bring into the project. Thankfully, we had the right people already working with us. There will be a substantial increase in new content in the coming weeks.  So with today's update here are some of the fixes you will see. There will be a lot more coming soon!

Thanks,

Ember Saga Team

FIXES

[OLIST]
Quest 3 (Veradactryx Terror) now completes correctly, including objectives
Quest 4 (Bear Necessities) now completes correctly, including objectives
Quest 7 (A Family in Need) now activates and completes correctly.
Quest 8 (The Planting of the Seed) now activates and completes correctly
Quest 9 (A God?! Can't be...) now activates and completes correctly
Quest 10 (Never should have asked...) now activates and completes correctly
Quest 13 (The Lost Ring) Ulthrip is now visible in the second stage of his quest
Save Crystal in the bandit hideout now works correctly
Some object clipping has been corrected

[/olist]

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE COMPLETE OVERHAUL
notes.content:
Hello, Ember fans!

Well, there are a few obvious changes that have happened, but we are pleased to announce that the entire system has been completely redone and works so well. We are excited to get your feedback on the new gameplay and direction! 

Our change log only covers some of the changes, but there is one MAJOR thing to note. This completely resets the game. You will have to start over from the beginning, but don't worry. There is a lot of new content even at the start. Our team has been working really hard to make sure this game is not only an amazing story with amazing characters, but we have taken to heart all the positive and negative feedback from our players. If you run into any bugs now, at the main menu you will find which beta build you are currently playing, enabling us to eliminate these bugs even quicker! 

We are excited to get your feedback on the title and look forward to delivering, even more, content in the days to come.

Regards,


The Ember Saga Team.

CHANGES

New Intro
New Title
New Icons
New Fonts
Maps Redone
New Quests Added
Enemies Added
Enemy Skills added
Gameplay Changes
All new skill system 
All new stat system
States added

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hello Embers!

This update is very bug and balance centered, but new content will be coming soon.  We appreciate you guys and please remember to become involved in the discussion boards.  Now, let's get to the patch notes.

BUG FIXES
Bug fixes
Animation Overlay
Event Stacking
Event Colliding
Fix crash of NPC face load

SKILL BALANCE UPDATE
Changes to skills
Magic costs increased
Magic damage increased
Melee Tp costs reduced
Some skills have received a small increase to critical hit rate

GAME PLAY CHANGES
Critical Hit - Increased base critical hit rate but lowered the base modifier to 2 instead of 3.
New CEV(Critical Evason Rate) stat which can give them an increased
resistance to critical hits. This is only being applied to fly enemies currently

MENU AND CONTROL FUNCTIONS
Added a better Keyboard Config feature
Added a better Save feature
Added an in-battle status feature

FUTURE UPDATE OUTLOOK

Next Update will focus on better-balanced Experience Curve
is targeted to be an end of April release
Next round of updates will include a new area, Wellington, with more story content and new quest lines

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Greetings Embers,

It has been a LONG time, but we had a lot of changes to make and fix this title.  After a lot of back end work we are finally ready to roll out our first major update.  Most changes are to the game play mechanics and battle balancing, but we have also added a lot of new content as well. The most obvious change is to the quest log and to our new, improved, and expanded over world.  You will start see more regular content coming from here out. We appreciate everyone's patience, and we look forward to bringing a better gaming experience to you.   Below are the changes we have made. You will most likely have to start the game over, which we have tried to avoid, but the changes have been too many for most saved games. 

ITEMS

Health Potion(Item)
Recovery now at 20%
Increased drop rate in Gazerbat and Ectophage.
Drought of Life(Item)
Recovery now 20% +10 HP.
(New Item) Bandit’s Delight
High drop rate from bandits type enemies
25% recovery
10% chance to gain state dizzy
(New Item) Honey 
5% Hp and Mp recovery
New  Dizzy (State)
80% defense, -5% hit rate, 2-7 turns or 50 steps
Add State Dizzy to Wine

CLASS CHANGES

Class Stat changes
+1 max hp per level
+0.5-1 defense on ranged classes
-0.5 defense on melee classes
-0.5 agility to all

GAME MECHANIC CHANGES

 Retreating from Battle
Retreat check 20% easier
+15 to party on check 
Fixed early levels inability to escape.
Changed defense and magic defense calculation
Armor is no longer a direct subtraction from attack value but is built as % of damage blocked. So both attack and defense now have a variation of number value. Giving better numbers. Example 2,2,2,2 was changed to 1,3,4,2.

ENEMY CHANGES

Hornet
Max hp down 15 to 12
Defense up 4 to 5
Honey added to drop
Cave & Swamp Ectophage
Defense down 10 to 8
Max hp up 15 to 22
All bandits
Defense down by 1

WORLD CHANGES
New game world map.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25720705/1e44c7b25c3bb7a512ab18332385c84cfcad5c3a.png

FUTURE UPDATE OUTLOOK

New Areas
Wellenton 
Gameplay mechanics
Quest rewards
Skill re-balancing
XP re-balancing

notes.title: Patch #1.2
notes.content:
Hello Embers,

We have been hard at work balancing out the game for you and continuing to work on the world of Mörja. I can tell you that we have more coming within the next two weeks including a new and improved overworld map (hint: it is a HUGE) and actual quest content.  We are working on delivering a quest log, in-game map, a resizing screen option, side quest content, and a new town to explore. Thanks again for all of your support, input, and help!  You all rock!

Thanks

The Forthright Team. 


Changelog v 1.2

Added Stat Distribution to the game.  Players can now adjust their stats separately of the skills.
Fixed magic skills to have base damage that is guaranteed.
Changed amount of SP given on level up.
Adjust EXP values to fit the values that we are looking for.
Adjust Crit chance and evals for dice rolls to allow for less critical hits.
Put down framework for new quest log and crafting/harvesting system.
Mana and Health Potions now heal for a % of your existing HP or MP. 
Changed the HP given on Draught of Life to a percentage.
Fixed the encounter rate so that you can ACTUALLY explore the game. 
Add more people to Upea Ranta and Lowland Creek.
Fixed some minor spelling errors. 
Added trading cards, backgrounds, and emoticons.

notes.title: Patch #1.1
notes.content:
Hello Embers!

We just released a decent patch today. We want to be clear that we consider a  PATCH just fixing bugs or other items that are minor.  When we post an  UPDATE, it will add new content or areas to the game as well as fix any bugs.  With this patch you should see a major update to gameplay and bug fixes.  As always, if you find bugs, post them in the forum.  Without further ado

 PATCHED ITEMS

    Game Auto run in full-screen. 
    Fixed Thrust skill
    Fixed Double Slash Skill
    Fixed Escape from combat Ratio
    Updated a TON of missing music
    Add battlebacks to more areas
    Add more characters (Will add more quests on next update)
    Adjusted the Experience curve for your characters
    Adjusted the Experience curve for enemies
    Fixed some spelling errors in text
    Added Mana Potions, called Magic Water, to stores in the game

notes.title: REPUBLIC OF TRYLISTA
notes.content:
HISTORY
 The Republic of Trylista is the only nation in Mörja that elects its leaders. Trylista’s economy is made up from farming, timber, and mining. The Republic earned its freedom 98 years ago after a four-year battle with the Kingdom of Evarst.  King Eladias II of Evarst was killed during the battle of the Bridge of Evarst, allowing his son, Prince Riganold, to rise to the throne. Prince Riganold was a righteous and wise young man and called for a meeting with General Prapaious of Trylista.  Riganold and Prapaious both felt that the conflict was costing too many lives and agreed to a peace treaty that many in the Kingdom of Evarst believed gave up too much land to Trylista.  The peace treaty was called The Treaty of Eladias. The boundary became the Dipar River with both nations agreeing to maintain the Bridge of Evarst in a joint cost effort.  Since this time the two nations have maintained a close bond both militarily, economically, and socially.  Trylista also maintains a peace with the Kingdom of Calindor. However, rumor has it that Calindor is looking to make gains to their territory, leaving The Republic of Trylista as the most likely to be attacked.

GENERAL INFO
Total Population - 84,000 People
Largest City - Trylista - 20,000 People
Main Export - Corn, Potatoes, Timber, Iron Ore
Ship of the Fleet - The Grand Prapaious
 

Current Leaders
Prime Minister - Brenden Belevant
President - Larea Wystazo
Ambassador to the Order - Thamos Pollain
Ambassador to Calindor - Thamos Grustov
Ambassador to Evarst- Monroy Baltarss
Order Commandant - Commandant Vlass
Order Ambassador to Trylista - Priestess Vanna 
Top Military Official - Field General Euriga

Military Info 
Army
Knights - 350
Calvary - 250
Warriors - 600
Generals - 5

Navy
Cutters - 10
Caravels - 5
Carracks - 2
Sailors - 450
Admirals - 2
